purpose: On licensed fresh HOLDOUT text, split the exact L11H3 write into the subject source term and the sum of every non-subject source term, then test their task effects and downstream interaction.

licensed_precondition.rows: Licensed HOLDOUT only; FIT remains forbidden.

motivating_result.finding: Complete opposite head improved donor margin and CE in all four cells. The opposite subject self term helped singular-to-plural but harmed plural-to-singular. This receipt uses no other new outcome to choose its split or bars.

prior_art_audit.finding: The canonical dossier contains source-value singleton and four-role value-group interventions, but no fresh natural full-term subject-versus-complement factorial.

The closest factorial used TEST_REUSE text, four semantic position groups, and donor effective values under recipient source scores. It did not replace natural donor source terms p_j u_j or test subject term versus the exact all-other-source complement.
The old registered object was a source-value role game, not the two-component natural-head partition registered here.

exact_partition.recipient_complement: C_r = sum over j != 8 of p_r,j u_r,j = H_r - S_r
exact_partition.opposite_complement: C_o = sum over j != 8 of p_o,j u_o,j = H_o - S_o
exact_partition.identity: S_r + C_r = H_r and S_o + C_o = H_o exactly up to registered float32 tolerance.

outcomes.donor_margin_improvement: Patched donor-answer-minus-recipient-answer margin minus the identical-index native margin; positive is better in both directions.
outcomes.donor_CE_improvement: Identical-index native donor-answer full-vocabulary CE minus patched donor-answer CE; positive is better in both directions.
outcomes.baseline: Every arm uses its exact index in a native 64-example batch with identical token order and batch shape.

opposing_predictions.interaction_repairs_plural_to_singular: In both plural-to-singular template cells, subject-only is harmful; the factorial interaction is positive in donor margin and CE on at least 3/4 rows and its mean donor-margin magnitude is at least the absolute subject-only harm.
opposing_predictions.complement_independently_carries_task: Complement-only improves donor margin and CE on at least 3/4 rows in every cell, has mean donor-margin effect at least 0.05, and recovers at least 70% of the complete-head mean margin effect.
opposing_predictions.complement_asymmetry_persists: Complement-only helps singular-to-plural but harms plural-to-singular by at least 0.05 mean donor margin, with matching answer-directed CE sign and at least 3/4 rows in each direction-template cell.

instrument_gate: Exact replay, source summation, same-batch native/no-op output, installed-head algebra, and complete-head capability must all pass before interpreting any scientific prediction.
terminal_policy: Preserve the three opposing predictions independently. Do not alter rows, combine templates, tune bars, or reinterpret negative CE as helpful after outcomes.
closed_claims: syntax generality beyond the licensed templates
